exposure: maternal caffeine intake during early pregnancy
maternal caffeine intake during late pregnancy
cohort: Women whose pregnancies and deliveries were treated at prenatal clinics in outpatient healthcare centers and Kuopio University Hospital in Finland between 2013 and 2022.
finding: Moderate (51-200 mg/day) and high (>200 mg/day) maternal caffeine intake during the first trimester of pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of delivering a Small for Gestational Age (SGA) baby, while caffeine intake in the third trimester was not.
birth_weight: SGA defined as birth weight corrected for gestational age below -2 standard deviations from the mean, according to sex-specific Finnish fetal growth curves.
gest_age: SGA defined as birth weight corrected for gestational age below -2 standard deviations from the mean, according to sex-specific Finnish fetal growth curves.
